phase3_findings.description: changelog.d/389.added.md line 10 still says `sqllens verify-memory` is not supported, contradicting changelog.d/400.added.md; criterion 19 requires a separate codex/changelog-notes-<reason> PR correcting it to merge before this PR, and no such correction is visible.

src/sqllens/eval/runner.py: _verification_metadata re-sets loaded.catalog.confirmed = True outside the state lock after confirm_catalog already set it under the lock; redundant and implies the runner owns that state.

src/sqllens/eval/runner.py: VerificationIdentityError.kind is a plain str rather than a Literal of the five kinds; describe() falls through silently for an unknown kind, and payload/kind invariants are only documented.
